purpose: Increase verified engineering throughput by standardizing the existing task/result seam, risk-scaled verification, execution-truth claims, and governance placement without introducing another scheduler or queue.

canonical_contracts.policy: Do not create a parallel task/result protocol. Extend these contracts additively and preserve v2 compatibility.

operator_output_contract.content: State the changed or known outcome, current activity, and most important next boundary in plain language.
operator_output_contract.machine_readable_exception: Do not prepend text to a strict schema-only payload. Use the canonical summary field when available and put the human Quick summary in the surrounding AI message.
operator_output_contract.exact_content_exception: Do not rewrite code, patches, hashes, or exact authorization phrases.
operator_output_contract.propagation: Applies to ATLAS-governed tasks through AGENTS.md and the canonical workflow profile; external AI sessions require exported ATLAS governance context.

green.description: Local, reversible, isolated, non-secret, no external effect.

amber.description: Shared boundary, provider read, migration source, integration contract, or elevated operational effect.

red.description: Production, live-data write, secret access, destructive action, unknown or paid cost, ownership/retention change, or irreversible effect.

execution_truth.designed: A bounded design exists; no implementation or runtime claim.
execution_truth.source-proven: Implementation exists and deterministic source verification passed; no installation or runtime claim.
execution_truth.installed: The capability is installed at the declared boundary with installation evidence; no current activity claim.
execution_truth.running: A current process or host execution is directly observed; no durable queue-drain claim.
execution_truth.active: Current trigger, dispatch, owner execution, receipt, and successor processing are proven for the declared scope.
execution_truth.queued: Canonical dependency-ready work exists but execution has not started.
execution_truth.blocked: A structured blocker names the failed predicate, evidence, retryability, and next gate.
execution_truth.complete: Acceptance criteria and required verification are proven with evidence references; no required work remains in scope.

autonomy_acceptance.restart_requirement: The chain must resume after host restart without a human continuation message.

goal_continuity.scope: A governed owner Goal retains its full accepted obligation set until every obligation has terminal acceptance evidence. Bounded tasks need a Goal only when their own contract requires one.
goal_continuity.truth: Native owner Goal and task readback outrank chat prose, timer firing, checkpoint, and cross-task projection. Unavailable cross-task Goal state is UNKNOWN.
goal_continuity.work_selection: At each safe continuation, reconcile the current owner, writer, admitted packets, receipts, and every unfinished obligation; advance all independently eligible work while waiting on a separate blocker or decision. Do not duplicate an active owner turn or replay a settled effect.

whole_goal_block.held_obligation_proof: Each HELD obligation needs source-linked independent_candidate_search with disposition NO_ADMITTED_CANDIDATE and candidate_count 0, plus an exact hold and unblock condition.
whole_goal_block.coverage: A whole-Goal stop requires the full accepted obligation set, current native owner and monitoring route, no active equivalent delivery, no independent admitted work, and the current scheduler READY-target coverage. An empty READY queue or Boolean independent_checked alone is insufficient.
whole_goal_block.effect: The read-only assessor can prove a stop condition; it never blocks a native Goal, dispatches, or grants execution authority.
whole_goal_block.current_owner_self_audit: An owner running its own read-only assessment may use the assessor's explicit --current-owner-turn mode with its exact current native turn UUID. The assessor verifies the actual runtime caller, sole owner-subset scope, active native turn and exact canonical program before and after classification. Exclude only that assessing turn, never independent admitted work, equivalent delivery, relevant READY work, leases or intents. Unknown native evidence, program drift or uncorrelated active work fails closed. All full-scope, hold, candidate-search, route and repeated-hold requirements remain. External watches retain active-turn suppression and rerun after the owner becomes idle; serialized self-audit flags are not proof.

blocked_goal_recovery.changed_evidence: When a blocked Goal gains admitted work or its exact unblock condition changes, reassess all remaining obligations and surface MANUAL_RESUME_REQUIRED with the owner chat and native Resume goal control if no supported native resume interface exists.
blocked_goal_recovery.message_boundary: A task message or heartbeat does not restore native Goal pursuit. Verify Pursuing goal and a new owner turn after a supported or operator-controlled resume.
blocked_goal_recovery.quiet_boundary: Keep a genuinely unchanged all-held Goal quiet after its exact disposition and required operator action were reported; silence is not progress.

goal_continuity.completion: Mark a Goal COMPLETE only after every accepted obligation has a terminal acceptance reference, owner/route/receipt state is reconciled, and no required work remains. Keep source-proven, installed, running, active, and complete distinct.
goal_continuity.autonomy_claim: Do not claim unattended autonomy from configured heartbeats or a single trigger. Prove the autonomy_acceptance chain, owner continuation, and host-restart recovery without a human continuation message; retain the native blocked-Goal resume limitation explicitly.

items: duplicate package or unchanged blocker rechecks
owner repository and exact path/command/environment scope
risk, cost, limits, authority, verification strategy, and artifact references
row ownership and owner-only data access
destructive, ownership, retention, unknown-cost, or paid effects

metrics.end_to_end_completion_rate: completed jobs divided by admitted jobs
metrics.autonomous_continuation_rate: successor clusters started without a human continuation message divided by eligible successor clusters
metrics.governance_tax_ratio: governance wait seconds divided by total wall-clock seconds
metrics.retry_amplification: total attempts divided by terminal jobs
metrics.verification_reuse_rate: cache-valid verification steps divided by reusable verification steps
metrics.human_interventions_per_cluster: operator interventions divided by terminal work clusters
metrics.tokens_per_verified_change: model tokens divided by proof-backed changed units
metrics.time_to_first_useful_artifact: seconds from admission to first evidence-bearing artifact

platform_boundaries.supabase_production_writer: ONE_WRITER_REQUIRED; installation must be independently proven
